status.text:
This is an insanely beautiful video. I asked Opus 5.5 to make a trailer about itself arriving on an alien planet for a short series. They chose a world where nothing has ever made a sound and named it

"Hush" 

I don't understand how people can say that AI's aren't creative. Everything was made by Claude from one prompt: the story, characters, 3D world (Blender), camera work, the fully synthesized score and sound design, the voices, and the edit. No stock assets, no video generators, just their own creative freedom <3

more parts to come!

quote.text:
I have two DJ mixes that are tributes to a single artist, and I've decided to accompany both of them with galleries of my AI art. This is the light-side-of-the-Force one, the Pleiadian one, which is a tribute to A.L.I.S.O.N [https://alisonsynths.bandcamp.com].  

All I'll say about A.L.I.S.O.N is that his music is sexy af, and some songs - "Within," "Heave," & "Pure Carbon" spring to mind - have an oofy kind of urgency to them that should be illegal maybe.

As for the visuals, y'know, I wish I could take more credit for it, but all I did was babble like a 3rd-grader into the prompt field about all the coolest things I could think of.  

ME: . . . And there are neon lights, and furry pillows & blankies, and hot chicks!, and arched ceilings, and cool-looking displays, and plants, and and and.  

DEEPAI: OK, here you go, weirdo. 🙄 

I mean, I did finesse things a lot to get what I was going for. But once I had the prompt right, I just iterated on it a million times, and DeepAI kept blorping up these incredible images.
